# Vera Makeup Studio

> Vera Makeup Studio is a bridal, editorial, and event makeup artist based in Vancouver, BC, Canada. The studio serves Metro Vancouver and the Lower Mainland with on-site (mobile) makeup and hair services. Contact is text-first: (+1) 778-951-0631 or veramakeupvan@gmail.com. Phone calls are not accepted.

## Services

- [Bridal Makeup Vancouver](https://veramakeupvan.com/services/bridal-makeup/): Wedding day hair and makeup, bridal previews/trials, and 6-10 hour on-site touch-up packages. Day-of hair and makeup from CAD 560.
- [Event and Party Makeup Vancouver](https://veramakeupvan.com/services/event-makeup/): Special occasion makeup for galas, birthdays, and celebrations, plus groom and men's grooming.
- [Editorial and Photoshoot Makeup Vancouver](https://veramakeupvan.com/services/editorial-photoshoot/): Camera-ready, flash-safe makeup for portraits, engagement and maternity shoots, branding, and editorial productions.
- [1:1 Makeup Lessons Vancouver](https://veramakeupvan.com/services/makeup-lessons/): Private makeup lessons teaching professional techniques on the client's own face.
- [Full Service Menu](https://veramakeupvan.com/services/): Complete pricing for all services.
